tools.name: get_cfr_section
tools.description: Read a CFR section. Use this when the user asks what a specific US federal regulation says, including an FDA, OSHA, EPA, SEC, FTC or FAA section of the eCFR, for example "what does 21 CFR 11.10 say?", "read 29 CFR 1910.134" or "show me 17 CFR 240.10b-5". Pass the CFR title number and the section num

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_federal_register, get_feedback_reply · Private data: search_federal_register · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_federal_register, get_feedback_reply · Private data: search_federal_register · Public sink: submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
